title: Employment Offer Letter
summary: A clear at-will job offer covering role, pay, start date, benefits and conditions.
useWhen: Offering a job to a new employee in the U.S. Pair it with your confidentiality and IP agreement and onboarding forms (I-9, W-4).
watchOuts: At-will employment is the U.S. default, but Montana requires good cause after a probationary period. Promises in an offer letter ('permanent position', 'job security') can undercut at-will status.
Classify the role correctly as exempt or non-exempt under the FLSA and state law. A salary alone does not make a role exempt.
A growing number of states and cities require pay ranges in job postings or on request, and some ban salary-history questions. Verify locally.
Non-competes are void or restricted in several states, for example California, Minnesota, North Dakota and Oklahoma, and many states limit them for lower-wage workers.
Every new hire must complete Form I-9 within three business days of starting work. Don't make the offer contingent on citizenship. Make it contingent on employment authorization.
Background checks require separate written disclosure and authorization under the federal Fair Credit Reporting Act, plus state and local rules.

variables.help: Date of this letter.

variables.help: Full legal name of the person, or the exact registered name of the company.

variables.help: Email address for notices.

variables.help: Title of the position.

variables.label: Reports to
variables.help: Name or title of the manager.

variables.label: Work location
variables.help: Office address, 'remote', or hybrid arrangement.

variables.label: Start date
variables.help: First day of work.

variables.label: Employment type
variables.help: Type of position.

variables.label: FLSA status
variables.help: Non-exempt employees must be paid overtime. Check the duties and salary tests.

variables.label: Pay basis
variables.help: Salary or hourly.

variables.label: Pay amount
variables.help: Annual salary or hourly rate.

variables.label: Pay frequency
variables.help: Check your state's minimum pay-frequency rules.

variables.label: Include bonus or commission?
variables.help: Describe any bonus or commission plan.

variables.label: Bonus or commission terms
variables.help: Eligibility, targets and timing. Say whether it is discretionary.

variables.label: Include equity grant?
variables.help: Stock options or other equity, subject to a separate plan and grant agreement.

variables.label: Equity terms
variables.help: Number and type of shares or options, vesting schedule and the plan name.

variables.label: Benefits summary
variables.default: You will be eligible for the benefits the Company offers to similarly situated employees, under the terms of each plan.
variables.help: Health, retirement, paid time off. Refer to plan documents.

variables.label: Paid time off
variables.help: E.g. '15 days per year, accrued per pay period', or as required by state or local law.

variables.label: Offer is contingent on
variables.default: Verification of your identity and authorization to work in the United States (Form I-9), and signing the Company's confidentiality and invention assignment agreement.
variables.help: Background check, references, licenses. Background checks need separate FCRA forms.

variables.label: Accept by
variables.help: Date the offer expires.

variables.label: State where the employee will work
variables.help: Employment law of the state where the employee works usually applies.

sections.title: 1. Offer
2. Pay
sections.body: Your pay will be {{pay_amount}} ({{pay_basis}}), paid {{pay_frequency}} and subject to required withholdings. This position is classified as {{flsa_status}} under the Fair Labor Standards Act and applicable state law.

sections.title: 3. Bonus or commission
sections.body:
{{bonus_terms}}

Any bonus or commission plan is governed by its written terms, which control if they differ from this letter.

sections.title: 4. Equity
sections.body: Subject to approval by the Company's board, you will be offered: {{equity_terms}}. The grant will be governed by the Company's equity plan and your grant agreement, which control.

sections.title: 5. Benefits and time off
sections.body:
{{benefits}}

Paid time off: {{pto}}. The Company may change its benefit plans from time to time, consistent with the law.

sections.title: 7. At-will employment
sections.body: Your employment with the Company is at will. Either you or the Company may end it at any time, with or without cause or notice, to the extent permitted by the law of {{work_state}}. Only a written agreement signed by an authorized officer can change at-will status. This letter is not a contract for any particular length of employment.

sections.title: 8. Company policies and prior obligations
sections.body: You agree to follow the Company's lawful policies. Please do not bring or use any confidential information belonging to a former employer. By accepting, you confirm that you are not bound by any agreement that would prevent you from performing this job, or you have told us about it in writing.

sections.title: 9. Accepting this offer
sections.body:
This letter, together with the documents it mentions, is the complete offer and replaces any earlier discussions. To accept, please sign below by {{accept_by}}. After that date the offer expires.

We look forward to working with you.

Sincerely,

{{employer_name}}

sections.body:
